title: Bring in the people you build with
body:
https://linear.app

Bring in the people you build with

 
You’ve had Linear to yourself so far, but building products is a team sport.
 
Triaging bugs, planning, and reviewing work all come alive when the people you build with are in the workspace.
 
Start by inviting the two or three teammates you work with most and run a real project, because that's a far better test of Linear
than exploring it alone.
 

Invite your team [https://linear.app/settings/members?utm_source=onboarding_flow]

If you need anything, reply to this email.
 
 
— The Linear Team
